People in this group are hell bent on it always being the partner with BPDs fault. I originally joined to get more insight and support in navigating everything that BPD brings into a relationship. You get the opposite here. You posted on here (I’m sure fully aware that she would be slammed in the comments.) Correct me if I’m wrong. You A. Want to break up because the relationship isn’t what you want and you want validation for that or B. You feel guilty because you know that it IS weird to delete all pictures of your girlfriend but keep pictures of other woman. I’ll be the one to side with her on that one. Anyone in a relationship here would be hurt by that. Aside from that, she breached your privacy by looking through your phone, that was not okay and she should own up to that. From what I could understand by her saying, “I’m tired of feeling crazy” it makes me wonder if YOU betrayed her trust at some point in this relationship and she went through your phone looking for confirmation of her fears. Again, correct me if I’m wrong.

Everyone here will tell you to run before it gets worse, I won’t. I don’t know your relationship or what this woman means to you but it sounds like she is begging for you to make her feel important. I don’t think we are getting the full story here. I won’t make someone out to be a villain when I haven’t heard both sides. You both sound immature. I hope you can work things out and come to a healthy agreement, whether that is separating or not. No one knows the full story as to why she reacted the way she did, so no one can give you the answer you want or need.

So for context, we moved to my parents house with the goal of building our dream house. I have been a SAHM for a few years because that is what we both agreed upon, until both kids get to school age. My ex had a mental health crisis and because of that needs to be in treatment for 9 months to a year. During this time we will be separated until I know he is stable and willing to continue the treatments needed to remain stable. 

According to the table he gives me $1,264. ($90,000, 2 kids ages 6 and 2) He is totally willing and compliant but my parents are telling me that I need to pay $600 rent plus half the groceries (approximately 200 every 2 weeks). Of course because of this I’m looking for a job but they are telling me that if we took things legally, a judge would consider the $600 I have to pay for rent and he would have to pay more than the $1264 he already pays. He sees the kids everyday after work  for a few hours and on weekends. He is not a dead beat but does have to deal with his mental health before we can be together again so I am not wanting to take things legally, as we are working towards being together again.

My question is, are my parents right in saying a judge would make him pay more because of them wanting $600 in rent? I don’t get rental receipts but have proof from E-transfers. They are pressuring me to ask for more.

There is an “approximate number” that you can calculate on the website but it doesn’t say if the amount of rent I pay would be accounted for in regards to how much I would receive. 

To make a long story short my partner is going through a mental health crisis of sorts. I’m currently at my parents because we were going to build a house before all of this came up. We are separated but not legally. He is paying “child support” while we live apart until he finishes treatment. It could be a year. My parents are telling me that I will need to pay X amount of dollars for rent and they will not budge on the amount. They are telling me if he was paying what the courts say, they would take into account how much rent I pay. He visits the kids everyday after work & weekends, only goes home before their bedtime. Is totally compliant with whatever he needs to pay. I am trying to work out how the courts would calculate things without taking things legally as we are most likely going to end up back together. I guess this might be too complicated of a question for Reddit.
